'''Neekoflights''' were an [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to rainforests on [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. These humorous cage birds were known for their unique beeping squawk. They also had a membranous display crest that opened up when the bird squawked.

==Behind the scenes==
Neekoflights appeared in the non-[[canon]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', where in-game [[Neimoidian]]s prepared a [[Neekoflight Pie|pie]] from their meat.<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
